summary: IBM Cloud gives new users credit for their first USD 200 of apps and services, usable on any IBM Cloud product for 30 days. To receive it you must upgrade to a Pay-as-you-go account; the credit is for first-time Pay-as-you-go accounts only, cannot be used with third-party offerings, and is applied automatically (it may take a few hours to appear). Separately, IBM Cloud offers 40+ always-free Lite plan products, including IBM Watson APIs.
claim_steps: The USD 200 promotional credit is applied automatically (may take a few hours)
Use the credit on any IBM Cloud product within 30 days
